run_entropy_plot: run the entropy_figure CLI tool with a config file to generate an Altair entropy chart
create_plot_entropies_config: create a PlotEntropiesConfig model with data_path, chart_path, and optional threshold override settings
create_plot_entropies_data: create a PlotEntropiesData model with text, threshold, and dataframe_json fields for entropy plotting
build_entropy_chart: build an Altair line chart showing entropy of next byte per token with a threshold rule line
override_entropy_scores: override entropy scores from a JSON file and recompute threshold-based patch rules for the chart
